info.description: ## Adam-atan2 - Pytorch Implementation of the proposed Adam-atan2 optimizer in Pytorch A multi-million dollar paper out of google deepmind proposes a small change to Adam update rule (using `atan2`) to remove the epsilon altogether for numerical stability and scale invariance It also contains some features for improving plasticity (continual learning field) ## Install ```bash $ pip install adam-atan2-pytorch ``` ## Usage ```python import torch from torch import nn # toy model model = nn.Linear(10, 1) # import AdamAtan2 and instantiate with parameters from adam_atan2_pytorch import AdamAtan2 opt = AdamAtan2(model.parameters(), lr = 1e-4) # forward and backwards for _ in range(100): loss = model(torch.randn(10)) loss.backward() # optimizer step opt.step() opt.zero_grad() ``` ## Citations ```bibtex @inproceedings{Everett2024ScalingEA, title = {Scaling Exponents Across Parameterizations and Optimizers}, author = {Katie Everett and Lechao Xiao and Mitchell Wortsman and Alex Alemi and Roman Novak and Peter J.
